final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), count_sum AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_count FROM state_counts), paired AS (SELECT sc.invoice_count, CAST(sc.invoice_count AS REAL) / cs.total_count AS count_ratio FROM state_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN count_sum AS cs WHERE cs.total_count IS NOT NULL), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(invoice_count) AS mean_count FROM paired), kept AS (SELECT p.invoice_count, p.count_ratio, p.invoice_count - a.mean_count AS count_difference FROM paired AS p CROSS JOIN avg_count AS a WHERE a.mean_count IS NOT NULL AND p.invoice_count > a.mean_count) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_count, AVG(count_ratio) AS average_count_to_sum_ratio, AVG(count_difference) AS average_count_minus_average FROM kept
